questions.stem: In hernia repair, which patient group most often needs the operation?
In what setting is hernia repair usually performed?
In an obstructed or incarcerated hernia, which two concerns shape the preoperative assessment?
questions.answer: Aspiration risk and possible ischaemic bowel

questions.stem: Before hernia repair, which condition should be treated to reduce recurrence?
In hernia repair, why treat COPD with chronic cough, BPH or ascites before surgery?
questions.answer: Raised intra-abdominal pressure predisposes to recurrence

questions.stem: In laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair, the hernia is often ____.
Which airway is commonly used for laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
For laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair, the neuromuscular blocker commonly used is ____.
What patient position is used for laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
questions.answer: Supine; left arm out, or both arms in

questions.stem: Which antibiotic is given for laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
What must the anaesthetist do during pneumoperitoneum in laparoscopic hernia repair?
How long does laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair usually take, unilateral or bilateral?
What blood loss is expected in laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
What morphine dose is given for moderate pain after laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
Which two non-opioid analgesics are given for moderate pain after laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
For PONV after laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair, what is suggested?
What is the usual postoperative stay after laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair?
Which airway technique is used for open hernia repair?
What patient position is used for open hernia repair?
In open hernia repair, when should the patient stay paralysed?
options: Until the hernia sac is opened

questions.stem: How long does open hernia repair usually take?
What morphine dose is given for moderate, size-dependent pain after open hernia repair?
For PONV after open hernia repair, given bowel handling, what is suggested?
What is the usual postoperative setting after open hernia repair?
In hernia repair, what roles can an inguinal field block play?
questions.answer: Sole technique or adjunct to GA

questions.stem: Where should the iliohypogastric and ilioinguinal nerves be blocked for hernia repair?
options: 2 cm caudal and medial to the ASIS
2 cm cranial and medial to the ASIS
2 cm caudal and lateral to the ASIS
2 cm cranial and lateral to the ASIS

questions.stem: In hernia repair, where is the genitofemoral nerve found for an inguinal field block?
questions.answer: 1–2 cm above the midpoint of the inguinal ligament, deep to the external oblique aponeurosis

questions.stem: In hernia repair, who can perform the genitofemoral nerve block to avoid vascular or peritoneal puncture?
What tramadol dose is given for discharge analgesia after day-case hernia repair?
What systemic analgesia does PROSPECT 2019 recommend for hernia repair?
questions.answer: Paracetamol plus NSAID or COX-2 inhibitor, started before or during surgery and continued after

questions.stem: Which drug given as a single IV dose does PROSPECT 2019 recommend for hernia repair?
Which local or regional techniques does PROSPECT 2019 recommend for hernia repair?
questions.answer: LA infiltration and/or regional analgesia (ilioinguinal/iliohypogastric block or TAP block)

questions.stem: When does PROSPECT 2019 recommend a local anaesthetic technique for hernia repair?
questions.answer: If the surgeon is experienced in it
